description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Frost Fair Lure Fish.
When Frost Fair Lure Fish enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Fish creature tokens and two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Fish tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Fish.
